name: UK RAMS / CDM Compliance Ruleset
description: An open, machine-readable checklist for auditing a UK construction Risk Assessment / Method Statement (RAMS) against the structural elements and hazard-specific controls expected under the Management of Health and Safety at Work Regulations 1999, the Construction (Design and Management) Regulations 2015 (CDM 2015), and related HSE Approved Codes of Practice. Intended for use by humans (self-checking a document before it goes to a Principal Contractor) and by software/AI agents that need a citable, structured rubric rather than free-text advice. Matching is deliberately conservative (keyword/phrase based) and is a screening aid, not a legal or engineering sign-off.
howToUse: Run each item's 'patterns' as case-insensitive substring/regex tests against the document text. For 'structural' checks, a match on any pattern (or all, if requireAll=true) means the element is present. For 'hazard' checks, first test 'triggerPatterns' — if none match, the hazard is not applicable and should be excluded from scoring. If a hazard IS triggered, test 'requiredPatterns'; if none match, flag it as a missing control. Sum matched weights / applicable weights for a percentage score. See engine.js in this same directory for a reference implementation.

grading.label: Needs work before use on site
High risk of rejection by a Principal Contractor

structuralChecks.name: Scope of works
structuralChecks.guidance: Add a clear 'Scope of Works' statement describing exactly what task is being done, where, and by whom. A RAMS without a defined scope can't be checked against the actual job.
structuralChecks.reference: Management of Health and Safety at Work Regulations 1999, reg 3

structuralChecks.name: Site / project details
structuralChecks.guidance: Name and address the specific site. A generic RAMS reused across sites without this is a common reason Principal Contractors reject documents.

structuralChecks.name: Person(s) responsible
structuralChecks.guidance: Name the competent person accountable for supervising this work and enforcing the RAMS on site.

structuralChecks.name: Issue date and review date
structuralChecks.guidance: Add both an issue date and a stated review date/period. An undated RAMS can't be checked for currency and will usually be rejected.
structuralChecks.reference: HSE INDG163 (five steps to risk assessment)

structuralChecks.name: Sequence / method of work
structuralChecks.guidance: Break the task into a numbered sequence of steps. This is the 'method statement' half of RAMS — without it, the document is a risk assessment only.

structuralChecks.name: Hazards identified
structuralChecks.guidance: List the specific hazards this task creates, not a generic statement that 'risks exist'.
structuralChecks.reference: Management of Health and Safety at Work Regulations 1999, reg 3

structuralChecks.name: Risk rating (before/after controls)
structuralChecks.guidance: Score each hazard's likelihood x severity before and after controls, so the effect of the controls is demonstrable.

structuralChecks.name: Control measures / safe system of work
structuralChecks.guidance: State the specific control for each hazard, ideally following the hierarchy of control (eliminate, substitute, engineer, administer, PPE).
structuralChecks.reference: Management of Health and Safety at Work Regulations 1999, reg 4 & Sch 1

structuralChecks.name: PPE requirements
structuralChecks.guidance: List the specific PPE required for this task (not just 'standard PPE'), matched to the hazards identified.
structuralChecks.reference: Personal Protective Equipment at Work Regulations 1992

structuralChecks.name: Training / competence requirements
structuralChecks.guidance: State what training, certification (e.g. CSCS, CPCS, IPAF) or competence operatives must hold before carrying out this task.

structuralChecks.name: Emergency procedures
structuralChecks.guidance: Describe what to do in an emergency: fire action, first aid arrangements, nearest hospital, and how accidents/near-misses get reported.
structuralChecks.reference: Management of Health and Safety at Work Regulations 1999, reg 8-10

structuralChecks.name: Plant / equipment / tools used
structuralChecks.guidance: List the plant, tools and equipment involved so their specific risks (and inspection status) can be assessed.
structuralChecks.reference: Provision and Use of Work Equipment Regulations 1998 (PUWER)

structuralChecks.name: Briefing / sign-off record
structuralChecks.guidance: Include a signature record showing every operative has been briefed on and understood this RAMS before starting work.
structuralChecks.reference: HSE good practice — demonstrating that a risk assessment was communicated

structuralChecks.name: Monitoring / supervision arrangements
structuralChecks.guidance: State how compliance with this RAMS will be checked on site (supervision, spot checks, inspections).
structuralChecks.reference: Management of Health and Safety at Work Regulations 1999, reg 5

structuralChecks.name: Welfare arrangements
structuralChecks.guidance: Confirm welfare facilities (toilets, rest area, drinking water) are available for the duration of the task.

structuralChecks.name: Environmental controls
structuralChecks.guidance: Note any environmental controls needed — dust, noise, waste disposal, or spill response — even for jobs that are primarily H&S focused.
structuralChecks.reference: Environmental Protection Act 1990 / local site environmental plan

structuralChecks.name: Document control
structuralChecks.guidance: Add basic document control: version/revision number and who prepared it, so superseded copies can be identified on site.
structuralChecks.reference: Good practice / ISO 9001 document control principles

hazardChecks.name: Working at height
hazardChecks.guidance: Working-at-height hazards were detected but no specific fall-prevention control (guardrails, harness/fall arrest, edge protection, scaffold inspection) was found.

hazardChecks.name: Excavation / groundworks
hazardChecks.guidance: Excavation work was detected but no control for collapse prevention (shoring/battering/support) or buried-services checks (CAT scan / services drawing) was found.
hazardChecks.reference: CDM 2015; HSG47 — Avoiding Danger from Underground Services

hazardChecks.name: Manual handling
hazardChecks.guidance: Manual handling was detected but no specific control (mechanical aids, team lifting, assessment) was found.

hazardChecks.name: Electrical work
hazardChecks.guidance: Electrical hazards were detected but no isolation/permit/competence control was found.

hazardChecks.name: Hot works
hazardChecks.guidance: Hot works were detected but no fire-control measure (permit, extinguisher, fire watch) was found.
hazardChecks.reference: Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005; HSE hot work guidance

hazardChecks.name: Confined space
hazardChecks.guidance: Confined space work was detected but no permit, gas testing or rescue plan was found.

hazardChecks.name: Asbestos
hazardChecks.guidance: Asbestos was mentioned but no reference to a survey, the asbestos register, or licensed-contractor requirements was found.

hazardChecks.name: Noise
hazardChecks.guidance: Noise was mentioned but no hearing-protection control or noise assessment was found.
hazardChecks.reference: Control of Noise at Work Regulations 2005

hazardChecks.name: Dust / silica (RCS)
hazardChecks.guidance: Dust/silica-generating work was detected but no suppression, extraction or RPE (respiratory protective equipment) control was found.
hazardChecks.reference: Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations 2002 (COSHH)

hazardChecks.name: Hazardous substances (COSHH)
hazardChecks.guidance: Hazardous substances were mentioned but no COSHH assessment or safety data sheet reference was found.
hazardChecks.reference: Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations 2002 (COSHH)

hazardChecks.name: Vehicles / site traffic
hazardChecks.guidance: Vehicle/traffic movement was detected but no traffic management or banksman control was found.
hazardChecks.reference: CDM 2015, Sch 2; HSE traffic management guidance

hazardChecks.name: Crane / lifting operations
hazardChecks.guidance: A lifting operation was detected but no lift plan, appointed person or LOLER-competent role was found.
hazardChecks.reference: Lifting Operations and Lifting Equipment Regulations 1998 (LOLER)

vagueLanguageFlags.message: "Suitable precautions" without naming them is a classic inspector red flag — say exactly what the precaution is.
"Adequate" is undefined — state the specific PPE, training or supervision level required.
"All necessary precautions" names nothing specific — list the actual controls.
"As required" is vague — specify what, when, and by whom.
"If necessary" leaves the decision undefined — state the trigger condition.
"Take care" is not a control measure — replace with a specific, actionable instruction.
